execution_speed_policy.scope: Four completed matched ABBA cases; timing receipts excluded from primary store digest. Update-stage sums are descriptive child work, never concurrent job wall. OS FILETIME and monotonic job clocks can differ; their difference is diagnostic. Two repetitions give observed variability, not a precise confidence interval.

collection_profile.semantics: Completed job wall comes from host-throughput phases including storage. Stage counters are inclusive; tensor encoding overlaps inference and search sub-stages overlap search. Worker seconds describe work and are never summed as elapsed completion. CPU rows are point samples. First versus later CUDA device calls are descriptive, not isolated startup causality.

limitations: Per-process update wall sums are not concurrent job wall.
Launcher phase sum excludes storage hold interval and recovery workflow.
Nested search counters overlap and must not be added as exclusive shares.
CUDA device counters measure host scopes, not actual GPU kernel service.
